newly_read_source.title: CRoute: A Fast High-quality Timing-driven Connection-based FPGA Router
newly_read_source.paraphrase: Same-source connections share costs through a sharing factor. Uncongested critical connections are rerouted. The reported routing-time boundary excludes RRG generation.
newly_read_source.supports_main: Same-net sharing and critical-connection rerouting are prior ingredients, not new mechanisms by themselves.
newly_read_source.comparison_limit: No reproduced CRoute baseline; different input suite, buffered device model and time boundary prohibit cross-paper numeric ranking.

qualification: Fresh full CRoute manuscript reading strengthens existing limited citation. AIR/Liu context is retained from the previously sealed primary-source review; no claim that unexamined prior work lacks a mechanism.
